//: The full state of Custom Apps 0.12.40: every object of the extension (core) and of its two apps (KidTube, Instagram), with example data. Generated from the code on 2026-10-21. Keep it current when a shape changes.

howToRead.//: JSON has no comments, so this file uses keys that start with //.
rules: "//": what the object is, where it lives, who writes it, who reads it (file:line or file function).
"//<field>": the variants of <field> (enum values, null cases, limits). The value next to it is one real-looking example.
"//shared": this object is COMMON to KidTube and Instagram (one shape, one code path in extension/core/). Search for //shared to find all common parts.
Example values are made up but realistic: profile leo.kidtube@gmail.com (KidTube), @anna.saves (Instagram), device tab-3f9a1c2e, the date 2026-10-21.
Paths without a folder start at extension/. Data repo paths start at the root of the private data repo (default andyvauliln/kidtube-data).

layers.chrome.storage.local: the tablet's state. Core keys + app keys. Per-profile keys move to acct:<key> on a profile switch (core/background/profiles.js useProfile).
layers.Cache Storage: big files (audio, avatar), fake host https://kidtube.invalid/
layers.data repo (GitHub, private): <app>/<folder>/... per profile; problems/, fixes.json, devices/ at the root
layers.message: { type, ... } from a page or content script to the service worker (core/background/messages.js) and its answer
layers.view: what a screen gets and renders

commonParts.//: What KidTube and Instagram share. Every item here is one shape in extension/core/ used the same way by both apps. The app column says what differs.

list.differs: KidTube: parentPage, modes (kid/parent), contextDocs. Instagram: home (launch address), modes:false.
KidTube names a profile by the YouTube email (by:'email'), Instagram by the username (by:'username').
Which members each app fills: see apps.<app>.contract.
Key: KidTube = the email; Instagram = 'instagram:@<username>'.

list.part: settings (PIN, mode, GitHub token, dev mode)
list.differs: Instagram always runs in mode 'parent' (modes:false).
KidTube: config, queue, memoryMeta, runStatus, answers… Instagram: handled.
none
none

list.part: ytAccount / igAccount (what the site page reported)
list.differs: One key per site: same idea, fields email/datasyncId vs username/id.
email for KidTube, username for Instagram.

list.part: Sync loop (15 min alarm, soon, syncIfStale) and the app's sync(ctx)
list.differs: The files each app reads and writes.

list.part: Apps header view (the 'header' answer) and its App | site switch
list.differs: KidTube: Parent | Kid switch, notes, questions. Instagram: switch App | Instagram, only a 'queued' AI row.
note/question rows exist only for KidTube (it has notes + questions); Instagram gives the 'queued' row.
Check ids: kidtube.* / action.* for KidTube, ig.read / ig.parentSent / instagram.* for Instagram.
none: one extension, one version for both apps.

list.part: Site rules (DNR: other websites closed, ads)
list.differs: KidTube: from its config. Instagram: fixed { block:true, allowed:[instagram.com, facebook.com], ads:false }.
Only Instagram reads a part of it today (instagram.reader).

Lives in KidTube's folder but Instagram's igNote uses the same transcribeAnswer and keys (instagram/keys.json, else kidtube/keys.json).

list.part: Voice notes about an item, sent to a server agent
list.differs: Same idea, two shapes: KidTube note events (voice/<id>.wav, voice/<id>.json); Instagram post notes (notes/<id>.wav, noteTexts in handled.json).

list.part: Server agent run on a request, its status in the data repo
list.differs: KidTube: requests/run.json → run-status.json. Instagram: posts.json (queued posts) → handled.json + posts/<id>.json.

onlyKidTube: Kid mode and parent mode, the PIN to leave kid mode, time limits, the lock, the list of videos, sessions, the talking friend, quizzes, parent screens (Today, Planned, History, Details, Prompt, Context, Settings), notes and questions for the AI, the nightly helper (memory.json, queue.json, helper.json).
onlyInstagram: Saved posts, collections, the reader of Instagram's pages and API (net.js, reader.js, api.js), the To-handle list, post notes, the posts agent's transcripts (handled.json, posts/<id>.json), the export file.

extension.//: The core: extension/core/ + apps/registry.js + manifest.json. It knows profiles, modes, the PIN, the header, sync, updates and checks. It knows nothing about videos or posts.

manifest.//: extension/manifest.json. ship sets the version; never by hand.
manifest.name: Custom Apps
manifest.//contentScripts: //shared: watch.js, bridge.js, header.js run on both sites.

constants.//TARGET: 'quetta' (Android, the source as written) | 'orion' (iPad/iPhone/Mac; build/build-orion.mjs rewrites it)
constants.//alarms: poll: every 15 min sync. soon: sync in 1 min (while the app waits for the server). bridge: every 1 min while dev mode is on.
constants.//DEVICE_SETTINGS: settings fields that belong to the tablet, not the profile: they move along with every profile switch

registry.//: apps/registry.js: plain data, read by the background and by the pages. //shared: one entry per app, same fields.

kidtube.label: KidTube (YouTube)
kidtube.about: His own video list on YouTube, with time limits and a talking friend.
kidtube.//: no page, no home: KidTube runs on YouTube itself. modes: default (kid + parent).

instagram.label: Instagram (saved posts)
instagram.about: Your saved posts: voice notes, and the AI writes down what each video says.
instagram.//: no parentPage: its screen is drawn by its content script over Instagram's own Saved page.

APPS.//fields: id, label, color, glyph (header.js PATH: play|square|camera|link|cloud|download|upload|caret|grid|bell|code), about, sites, account (a SITES key), page? (extension page shown instead of YouTube), parentPage?, home?, modes? (false: no kid/parent), contextDocs

registry.//DEFAULT_APP: the app of a profile saved without one (profiles from before there were apps)

SITES.//: the sites whose signed-in account names a profile. stored = the storage key of what the page reported. home null = the YouTube in use (m. or www.).

appContract.//: core/background/apps.js: the background part every app registers (apps/backgrounds.js lists them). All fields optional but id. //shared: the core asks the current profile's app through these members.

members.stateKeys: storage keys kept per profile, changed through withState()
members.profileKeys: more storage keys kept per profile, written outside withState
members.fileKeys: storage keys that go into the settings file (header: Save / Load)
members.prepare(s): fills empty state keys with defaults before withState's fn runs
members.guard(s, tabId, c, href): a YouTube page in the app (c = lib/youtube.js classifyUrl): a URL to send the tab to, or null
members.view(s): what the app's screens on YouTube need (spread into the 'state' answer)
members.handlers / pageOnly: { type: (msg, ctx) => answer }; pageOnly: types only extension pages may send
members.sync(ctx): the app's files; ctx { loc:{repo,base}, token, data, status, acct }; false = the profile changed meanwhile
members.beforeSync(msg): the 'sync' message from the app's own pages
members.aiView(s): for the 🔔: { held, run, message, at, page, send, report } or { queued }
members.waiting(s): true: the core syncs every minute (alarm soon)

whoFillsWhat.//: ✓ = the app gives it. See apps.<app>.contract for the values.

storage.//: chrome.storage.local keys of the core. Per-profile core keys: settings, data, syncStatus (store.js CORE_KEYS).

settings.//: Per-profile key, but every field in use is a DEVICE_SETTINGS field (moves along on a switch). Writers: core/pages/pin.js, core/lib/pin.js, profiles.js connectGitHub/importSettings, sync.js settingsBackup, bridge.js setDevMode, messages.js setMode/kidHome, apps/kidtube/background/sync.js (deviceId). //shared.
settings.//pinHash: base64 PBKDF2-SHA256, 150000 iterations; missing = no PIN chosen yet
settings.//pinFails: 0..5; 5 wrong PINs lock the PIN page
settings.//pinLockedUntil: 0 | ms epoch (e.g. 1792575000000) until the PIN page opens again
settings.//deviceId: KidTube's device id (activity files). NOT the same as checks.device (problem reports, dev mode).
settings.//token: a GitHub token with write access to the data repo; missing = nothing syncs
settings.//devMode: true: the dev mode bridge runs (agents test this tablet)
settings.//devKey: 64 hex chars while devMode is on; deleted when off
settings.//readOnly: true only in the lab browser (agent/lab/lab.mjs): putRepoFile writes nothing

account.//: The current profile. Built by profiles.js useProfile; folder and app filled by store.js profileBase. Read by nearly every module. //shared: the variant shows the app's own fields.
account.//key: keyFor(app, name): KidTube = the lowercase email (or 'yt:<datasyncId part>' without one); other apps = '<app>:<name>' ('instagram:@anna.saves')
account.//folder: profileFolder(): the username or the email's local part, cleaned to [a-z0-9._-]; a clash adds -<domain part>, then -2, -3. Given once, never moves. Repo folder = <app>/<folder>/

accounts.//: Map: profile key → record (profiles.js profileRecord). Read by the header (apps list), openApp, profileBase, the start.profile check. //shared.

acct:<key>.//: A profile that does not run now: all its per-profile keys as they were (profiles.js useProfile). Example key: 'acct:instagram:@anna.saves' while KidTube runs. //shared.
acct:<key>.//appKeys: KidTube: watched, today, session, outbox, localConfig, seen, pendingTalk, quizTurn, transcripts, character, repoAvatars, planLog, history, notes, memory, helperInfo, contextDocs. Instagram: ig, igAudio.

shell.//: The apps header state (store.js shellOf). Writers: profiles.js youtubeAccount, openApp, plainSite, leaveApp. Readers: guard.js, sites.js, core/content/shell.js through 'state', the header. //shared.
shell.//on: true: no app runs, the site is plain with the apps header on top. Missing key: { on: !account, locked: false }
shell.//locked: true: the site is covered until a grown-up enters the PIN (the site's account changed)
shell.why: YouTube is signed in to bob@gmail.com, not leo.kidtube@gmail.com: KidTube stopped.

siteAccounts.//: What each site's page reported last: key = SITES[x].stored. Written by profiles.js youtubeAccount / siteAccount. Read by seenOn() (header 'here'), openApp, connect. //shared idea, one key per site.
siteAccounts.//ytAccount.email: null when YouTube is signed out or gives no email
siteAccounts.//igAccount.username: null when signed out; must match /^[a-z0-9._]{1,30}$/; id must be 1–30 digits

data.//: What the last sync fetched for the profile. The core uses only profileFile; the rest belongs to the app (apps.<app>.storage.data). //shared key, app-specific content.
data.//etags: { path: etag } for If-None-Match; both apps keep one

syncStatus.//: core/background/sync.js doSync. Read by the 🔔 sync row, syncIfStale, the problem context, KidTube Settings, Instagram's status line. //shared.
syncStatus.//errors: e.g. 'GitHub says the token is wrong or expired. …', 'Waiting for the YouTube account: open YouTube once, signed in. …', 'posts.json: …'
notes: New profile: kidtube/leo.kidtube/ has no queue.json yet. The server sets it up within a minute or two.

repoProfiles.//: Cache of the profiles found in the data repo (profiles.js readRepoProfiles). Fresh for 10 min. Removed by connectGitHub and importSettings. Read by the header's apps list. //shared.
repoProfiles.//error: null | 'GitHub did not answer in 6 s: …'

siteOffer.//: The header's tile opened the plain site and offers 'switch to the app?' (profiles.js plainSite). Valid 1 h. Read by Instagram's igSite; removed by igOfferDone, siteAccount, connect.

profileDropped.//: A profile removed at start because it cannot be kept (profiles.js migrateProfileKeys). Read by the start.kept check.
profileDropped.//why: 'no username' (an old Instagram profile named by an email) | 'app gone'

storage.remote: see extension.site.remoteJson (cached as { at, data, error? })
storage.//dnrWorks: sites.js: the browser applies declarativeNetRequest rules (Orion may not)
storage.//bgStuck: store.js serial: a background step that took more than 20 s. Shown on the check page.
storage.//checkAlert: runner.js addReport → core/ui/watch.js banner and the header (opens the 🔔). takeAlert adds willSend: !!token.
storage.//bridgeLog: dev mode: how many commands the agents ran; shown in the dev pill
storage.//inboxHidden: header.js: rows the parent swiped away, by '<status.text>|<tries>' (a new status shows the row again)
storage.checkEcho: a random string, set and removed by the start.storage check
storage.//legacy: profileHold (0.9.4–0.9.7) and settings.parentUntil (<0.8.9) are removed at start (main.js)

sessionStorage.//checkSteps: ≤40 recent steps for problem reports (runner.js step)

pageStorage.//: Storage of web pages, not of the extension

kidtube-settings-backup.//: localStorage of the install page andyvauliln.github.io/kidtube/ (core/content/backup.js). Restores the token and PIN after a reinstall when settings.token is missing.

memoryState.//: Service worker memory: lost on restart, which is fine

dataRepo.//: Core files in the data repo. //shared.

sync.//: background/sync.js syncInstagram(ctx) (//shared ctx). Steps: 1) no token → stop 2) GET handled.json (etag) 3) pullKeys → repoKeys 4) an empty tablet: GET posts.json → restoreFromRepo 5) copy noteTexts into notes 6) PUT each igAudio → notes/<id>.wav 7) rev ≠ pushedRev → PUT posts.json. A 409/422 reads the sha again and tries once more.
